LCOM-SRC.description: Load Combination for SRC Design (LCOM-SRC). One entry per load combination id; each combination carries a list of (analysis type, load case, factor) terms in vCOMB that define how load cases are summed for SRC (steel-reinforced-concrete composite) design checks.

NO.description: Read-only combination number assigned by the program on GET; ignored on write.

NAME.description: Combination name. Must be unique when adding a new combination.

ACTIVE.description: Active type of the combination. Typical values: "ACTIVE", "INACTIVE", "STRENGTH", "SERVICE".

bES.description: Elastic-stage flag. Applies only to the concrete design combination type; has no effect for the SRC combination type, so it is ignored on write here.

bCB.description: Read-only min/max combination-type flag (true when the combination is a min/max/all envelope). Ignored on write.

iTYPE.description: Summation method. Add: 0, Envelope: 1, ABS: 2, SRSS: 3.

iSERV_TYPE.description: EC service type code (currently not applied on write).

nLCOMTYPE.description: EC load-combination type code (currently not applied on write).

nSEISTYPE.description: EC seismic type code (currently not applied on write).

vCOMB.description: List of combination terms. Each term references a load case (by analysis type and name) and its participation factor.

ANAL.description: Analysis type of the referenced load case (case-insensitive). ST=static, RS=response spectrum, TH=time history, MV=moving load, SM=settlement, CS=construction stage, CB=general combination, etc. Validity is hard-enforced at runtime.

LCNAME.description: Name of the referenced load case; must exist for the given analysis type.

FACTOR.description: Participation factor applied to the referenced load case.
